overview: Moose Jaw counted 33,665 residents in the 2021 Census, down 0.7 percent from 33,910 in 2016. The median household income was $74,000 in 2020, and 14,719 dwellings occupied by usual residents sit on 65.81 square kilometres.

The air base, agri-food processors and a busy tourism trade keep the economy diverse. With a flat population, a local business grows by taking share, keeping customers loyal and catching visitors and rural shoppers who come into town.
